source_rule: SB-ASI-P2593..SB-ASI-P3072 are Sourceborn operational parameter identities. AI/ASI/Sequence ownership fields are additive bindings and never replace the source System=Sourceborn identity.

ownership_dimensions.functional_domain_role: Inherited from E01..E08 Phase-2 role in the approved operational spine.
ownership_dimensions.ai_mechanism_binding: Which AI-01..AI-25 segments provide cognition/mechanism functions for the element.
ownership_dimensions.asi_governance_binding: Which ASI-01..ASI-20 segments govern authority, truth, memory, safety, priority, evolution or closure implications.
ownership_dimensions.sequence_runtime_binding: Which Universal Sequence runtime controls own trigger/threshold, failure routing, return/acceptance or closure behavior.

1.name: Activation Trigger
1.authority_rule: The operational parameter may supply/evaluate domain conditions but cannot bypass the Sequence threshold/barrier law.

2.name: Input Normalisation
2.authority_rule: Normalization cannot erase source ownership, epistemic status, contradictions or typed nulls.

3.name: Cross-Engine Synthesis
3.authority_rule: Engine outputs remain bounded inputs; synthesis cannot promote disagreement to consensus without an explicit resolution Sequence.

4.name: State and Confidence Update
4.authority_rule: State/confidence update cannot fabricate evidence or silently convert USER_EVIDENT into independently verified truth.

5.name: Failure and Contradiction Response
5.authority_rule: No in-place retry. Repair, investigation and retest are separate Sequences with their own closure and return contracts.

6.name: Validated Commit and Feed-Forward
6.authority_rule: A local validated result may be returned upward, but parent scope must accept it and re-evaluate its own contract; no terminal-status inheritance.

hard_guards: Do not rename SB-ASI-P2593..SB-ASI-P3072 as AI-P or ASI-P source IDs.
Do not collapse Sourceborn runtime, AI cognition and ASI governance into one owner field.
AI candidate generation or execution never implies authority.
ASI governance never manufactures source truth or bypasses Universal Sequence threshold/barrier/closure law.
Universal Sequence runtime controls remain distinct from AI and ASI rubrics.
